subject.title: fix(windows): remove findstr from scheduled-task restart probe (Fixes #84600)

question: Should this PR wait for live Windows Task Scheduler proof before merge, or will a maintainer supply or explicitly override that proof requirement?
rationale: The patch is narrow and source-reproducible, but the user-visible claim is native Windows windowing and restart availability, which generated-script tests cannot prove.

options.title: Require Windows restart proof
options.body: Ask for redacted Windows Task Scheduler, terminal, or desktop proof showing the helper completes, no cmd/findstr window appears, and the Gateway comes back up.

options.title: Maintainer supplies proof or override
options.body: A maintainer can run the Windows proof themselves or deliberately accept the source-only availability risk before merge.

recommendation.title: Require Windows restart proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted Windows Task Scheduler, terminal, or desktop proof showing the helper completes, no cmd/findstr window appears, and the Gateway comes back up.

likelyOwner.reason: `steipete` is the current assignee and therefore the best available owner for deciding the proof path.
